text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased p99 tail latency observed for streaming API (region: us-east-1). Starts at 23:42 UTC. Automated threshold crossed (p99 > 1.5s)

alex.oncall: seeing it, joining. pulling p95/p99 dashboards now.

maria.sre: confirmed + spike in streaming stalls (clients reporting stalled chunks). p95 up ~200ms -> 450ms, p99 ~220ms -> ~1.8s.

sahil.eng-runtime: any deploys around 23:40? I see a small rollout for prefix-hash v2 at 23:35 in dedicated pool.

jess.support: ticket queue shows 3 customers complaining about partial streams and timeouts. one customer notes resumed after retry.

alex.oncall: ok hypothesis: prefix cache hit-rate drop after prefix-hash change -> more backend fetches -> higher tail. Maria, can you check prefix cache hit-rate graphs?

maria.sre: checking... cache hit-rate (global prefixcache) dropped from ~87% -> ~32% at 23:36. evictions spiked.

ops-bot: Deployment event: `deploy-service prefix-hash v2` completed at 2026-02-11T23:35:12Z by sahil.eng-runtime.

sahil.eng-runtime: yup that rollout changed prefix salt -> incompatible with some hot-keys in prefetch table. We have a known migration path but looks like the rollout didn't warm new prefixes.

alex.oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) pause rollout 2) enable fallback to v1 prefix calculation on gte 50% of requests 3) spin up extra prefetch workers for 10m. Who can run the commands?

sahil.eng-runtime: I'll pause the rollout. running:```bash
kubectl rollout pause deployment/prefix-hash-controller -n inference
# pause confirmed
```

sahil.eng-runtime: enabling runtime fallback toggle (feature flag) now: `redwood-config set prefix_hash_fallback=on --scope=region:us-east-1`

maria.sre: prefetch worker scale up: `k8s scale deploy prefetcher --replicas=6 -n inference`; scaled from 2 -> 6. Observing increased prefetch traffic.

alex.oncall: monitoring OTel traces and KV cache metrics. Any immediate change?

maria.sre: within 70s we see cache hit-rate starting to rebound: 32% -> 62%. p99 trending down to ~900ms. Still above SLO but improving.

jess.support: updated affected customers: "We're investigating elevated streaming latency in us-east-1. We have mitigations in-flight and will follow up." They asked for ETA for full recovery.

priya.prod-ops: quick check: are any customers experiencing increased error rate (5xx)?

maria.sre: 5xx for streaming API increased from 0.2% -> 0.9% at peak, now ~0.4% after mitigations.

alex.oncall: ok continue mitigation until metrics stable for 15m. priority: avoid SLO breach window extending. Maria, keep eye on p95/p99. Sahil, plan rollforward rollback decision. Jess, keep support messages updated.

sahil.eng-runtime: dev note: v2 changed salt hashing to reduce namespace collisions but we missed a pre-warm step. Plan options: roll back to v1 immediately (fast) OR complete controlled rewarm + small canary (safer). I recommend rollback to v1 for now to restore hit-rates quickly.

priya.prod-ops: any risk to data integrity from rollback?

sahil.eng-runtime: none. It's stateless calculation. Rollback command ready:```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/prefix-hash-controller -n inference
```

alex.oncall: do it. coordinate with Maria to watch metrics and Jess to notify customers.

sahil.eng-runtime: executing rollback. monitoring pods come up.. rollback completed at 23:48:15Z.

maria.sre: after rollback: hit-rate back to ~88% within 2m. p99 down to ~260ms, p95 ~420ms -> ~220ms. streaming stalls reduced significantly.

jess.support: updated customers: "Mitigation applied (rollback). Services are recovering; we expect normal latency within minutes. We'll follow up with a root-cause update and postmortem." Customers acknowledged. :thumbsup:

alex.oncall: SLO impact assessment: p99 breached briefly for ~12 minutes. We hit a hard SLO threshold for that period in us-east-1. Need to flag this for SLO reporting and postmortem.

maria.sre: capturing timeline and graphs. saving traces for top slow traces and client IDs. Also capturing prefetch worker logs and eviction traces.

priya.prod-ops: any customer escalations requiring direct outreach?

jess.support: no high-severity escalations yet; some tier-2 customers had intermittent stalls but no data loss.

alex.oncall: next steps before handoff: 1) collect artifacts (metrics + traces + deploy events) 2) open incident postmortem ticket with RCA: prefix-hash v2 rollout missed pre-warm path -> low hit-rate -> backend fetch surge -> increased tail 3) action items: add prewarm step to rollout, require canary at 1% traffic, add automated rollback if hit-rate drop >20% 4) notify SRE lead + PM.

maria.sre: I'm creating a postmortem ticket: INC-20260211-001. attaching graphs and queries.

alex.oncall: handing off to sahil.eng-runtime for continued follow-up and remediation implementation. I'll be offshift in 25m. If anything regresses, @sahil.eng-runtime is primary.

sahil.eng-runtime: acknowledged. I'll own the rollout fixes and add the prewarm + canary checks. ETA for fix PR ~3h.

alex.oncall: handoff checklist posted below:
- current state: stable, hit-rate ~88%, p99 ~260ms
- mitigations applied: rollback to v1, scaled prefetchers, fallback toggle briefly enabled
- customer impact: temporary p99 SLO breach for ~12m, ~3 customers reported streaming stalls, no data loss
- artifacts: saved traces, eviction logs, deploy event logs (INC-20260211-001)
- owners: sahil.eng-runtime (remediation), maria.sre (postmortem + metrics), jess.support (customer comms)

priya.prod-ops: tagging oncall rotation: next oncall is casey.oncall at 00:20 UTC. please sync before you sign off.

alex.oncall: pinging @casey.oncall now. I'm going to sign off in 10m but will stay available for questions.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: postmortem due in 3d. Create follow-up tasks in backlog.

sahil.eng-runtime: quick note: adding unit/integration tests for prefix hashing; making prewarm script idempotent. PR will reference INC-20260211-001.

alex.oncall: thanks everyone. closing live incident channel in 30m if no regressions. final status: mitigated -> stabilized -> follow-up required (postmortem + rollout policy changes).

jess.support: will prepare customer-ready summary once postmortem draft is available.

maria.sre: logs and traces archived to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-20260211-001/

alex.oncall: handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
